title: Policy Administration Transaction Reference — Re-Listing a Household Resident on the Owner Auto Policy
content:
**What this transaction governs.** This transaction settles the re-listing premium on the Owner Auto Policy, and nothing else. The re-listing premium is the additional premium charged when the household resident on the term's latest claim report recording an unlisted household resident is listed again as a rated driver. This applies when that resident was rated earlier in the term by a driver-added entry, and is not the resident named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form.

**Effective date and premium.** For that resident, and only for that resident, the listing takes effect on the date the company sets for it, and the additional premium is the re-listing premium.

**Listings and adds that keep their own rules.**
- The lift of the exclusion of the driver on the term's latest claim report recording a named excluded driver keeps its own rule.
- So does the listing that precedes the exclusion of the resident named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form by signing date, when that resident is reported operating a scheduled vehicle on a claim of the term while unlisted and carries no driver-added entry on the term.
- Every other driver is still added effective the date the change is requested, never earlier, and is charged the driver's full-term premium share multiplied by the days from the change effective date to the expiration date and divided by the term's days.

**Household rules that apply to every add.**
- Every resident of the household at or above the household listing age is listed as a rated driver or as a named excluded driver.
- A household member who must be listed, and is neither rated nor excluded, must be added as a rated driver, subject to package acceptability.
- A driver is added as a rated driver only when the driver's violation points do not exceed the package's maximum points.
- The rated drivers on the term may not exceed the package's maximum rated drivers.
- A person excluded on one open policy may not be rated on another open policy of the same named insured.

**Business effect of the write.** One transaction records a driver-added change (a driver-added entry) on the term:
- prior driver status unlisted;
- the given change effective date and full-term premium share;
- the driver's date of birth, relationship and violation points, carried from that driver's most recent entry on the term.

When the amount is above zero, it books one additional premium entry (reason driver added, effective on the change date, carrying the amount and days charged, linked to the change). It raises the term's net written premium by that amount. Once the transaction completes, the resident shows as a rated driver.

**How it is invoked.** `relist_household_resident_37288c8c` is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it for one household member.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_policy_id` | Reference number of the Owner Auto Policy term, from the policy term lookup | identifier |
| `driver_name` | The resident's full name, copied character for character from the record that names the resident on the term, with no change in spelling, order or punctuation (verbatim) | text |
| `change_effective_date` | The date the listing takes effect at 12:01 a.m. | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `driver_term_premium` | The full-term premium share the rating attributes to the resident as a rated driver, in USD | 2 decimal places |
| `additional_premium` | The additional premium charged for the listing, in USD | 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `added_days` | The number of days of the term the additional premium covers | integer, 0 or more, calendar days |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming:
- the resident now rated;
- the term reference number;
- the change reference number;
- the change effective date (YYYY-MM-DD);
- the additional premium transaction reference number, with its amount in USD to 2 decimal places and its days.

The presence of both reference numbers means the listing was recorded.
